# working-tree-and-current-branch-untouched

Publishing must not change the repository's current branch (HEAD remains on the original branch) nor alter uncommitted working-tree files; the publisher's changes must not be staged into the repo index.

Avoid side effects on developer workspaces and local changes while performing publishing operations.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_publisher.py` — `tests.test_publisher.test_working_tree_and_current_branch_untouched`
